stories.title: Los Reyes visitarán Ceuta y Melilla los días 13 y 14 de octubre

en.title: The King and Queen will visit Ceuta and Melilla on October 13 and 14
en.summary: Spain's King Felipe and Queen Letizia will visit the autonomous cities of Ceuta and Melilla on October 13 and 14, following coordination between the Government and the Royal Household.

stories.title: La Aemet activa los avisos rojos en Tarragona, Castellón y Valencia por lluvias y tormentas

en.title: Aemet activates red alerts in Tarragona, Castellón and Valencia for heavy rain and storms
en.summary: Spain's meteorological agency has issued red alerts for coastal areas of three eastern provinces due to severe storms and heavy rainfall expected from Thursday, with orange alerts in additional regions.

stories.title: La Aemet decreta aviso rojo por lluvias torrenciales en Castellón, Valencia y Tarragona

en.title: Aemet issues red alert for torrential rain in Castellón, Valencia and Tarragona
en.summary: Spain's meteorological agency has declared a red alert for three eastern provinces facing extremely heavy and persistent rainfall exceeding 90 liters per hour, with the severe weather episode lasting until Monday.

stories.title: Los Reyes visitarán Ceuta y Melilla el 13 y 14 de octubre, en un viaje histórico al que no acudirá Sánchez

en.title: The King and Queen will visit Ceuta and Melilla on October 13 and 14 in a historic trip that Sánchez will not attend
en.summary: King Felipe and Queen Letizia will travel to the autonomous cities of Ceuta and Melilla on October 13 and 14, fulfilling a royal promise, in a visit that Prime Minister Sánchez will not join.

stories.title: La primera mujer condenada a muerte en Tennessee en 200 años sobrevive a las inyecciones letales

en.title: First woman sentenced to death in Tennessee in 200 years survives lethal injections
en.summary: Christa Pike, the first woman facing execution in Tennessee, survived two lethal injections and was hospitalized. Her legal team cited difficulties accessing veins, while witnesses reported she continued breathing after receiving the pentobarbital injection.

stories.title: Una mujer de Tennessee sobrevive a su ejecución tras 30 años en el corredor de la muerte

en.title: Tennessee woman survives execution after 30 years on death row
en.summary: Christa Pike survived two doses of pentobarbital and was transferred to a medical facility. Her death sentence remains in effect, but no new execution date has been announced and the response protocol for this situation remains unclear.

stories.title: La Generalitat manda un Es-Alert por "peligro extraordinario" de lluvias en Valencia y Castellón y se suspenden las clases en los colegios

en.title: Generalitat issues Es-Alert for "extraordinary danger" from heavy rain in Valencia and Castellón; school classes suspended
en.summary: Regional authorities issued a mass emergency alert Thursday morning about severe rainfall risks. About thirty municipalities suspended classes Thursday afternoon and Friday.

stories.title: Ayuso recurre a la justicia para desalojar la acampada de Sol

en.title: Ayuso appeals to courts to evict Sol encampment
en.summary: Madrid's regional government is pursuing legal action to remove an encampment at Sol square, blaming inaction by the central government delegation.

stories.title: Conde-Pumpido insta al Supremo a tomar la "decisión adecuada" sobre la amnistía y recuerda que la doctrina del TC es "vinculante"

en.title: Conde-Pumpido urges Supreme Court to make the "right decision" on amnesty and reminds that Constitutional Court doctrine is "binding"
en.summary: Spain's Prosecutor General Conde-Pumpido called on the Supreme Court to reach the correct decision regarding amnesty legislation, emphasizing that Constitutional Court precedent is mandatory and urging parties to fulfill their constitutional obligations.

stories.title: Aviso rojo por peligro extraordinario de lluvias torrenciales en Valencia y Castellón

en.title: Red alert for extraordinary danger of torrential rains in Valencia and Castellón
en.summary: Spain's weather agency AEMET elevated the risk level for torrential rainfall in coastal and interior areas of the Valencian Community, with emergency authorities issuing alerts to residents.

stories.title: Los Reyes viajarán a Ceuta y Melilla los días 13 y 14 de octubre

en.title: The Spanish Sovereigns will travel to Ceuta and Melilla on October 13 and 14
en.summary: Spain's royal household announced a visit by the King and Queen to the autonomous cities of Ceuta and Melilla, coordinated between the government and royal house, with full details to be released soon.

stories.title: La primera condenada a muerte en Tennessee en 200 años sobrevive a una doble inyección letal

en.title: Tennessee's first woman sentenced to death in 200 years survives double lethal injection
en.summary: A 50-year-old woman convicted of torturing and murdering her friend in 1995 survived a lethal injection procedure in Tennessee, leading authorities to suspend the execution and transfer her to hospital care.

stories.title: El Ibex sucumbe a los nuevos máximos de la deuda

en.title: The Ibex succumbs to new debt highs
en.summary: The Ibex faces pressure as debt interest rates reach record levels, offsetting positive signals from Micron Technology results and declining oil prices below 100 dollars.

stories.title: Garamendi, reelegido presidente de la CEOE para un tercer mandato

en.title: Garamendi reelected CEOE president for a third term
en.summary: Antonio Garamendi has been reelected as president of Spain's business confederation CEOE for a third consecutive mandate.

stories.title: El inquilino ya no tiene que indemnizar al casero si se va antes de acabar el contrato

en.title: Tenants no longer must compensate landlords if they leave before contract ends
en.summary: A decree published in Spain's official gazette modifies rental law to reduce contractual obligations for tenants regarding early lease termination.

stories.title: El Corte Inglés se hace con el 100% de su filial de Viajes tras comprar el 25% a Tool Factory

en.title: El Corte Inglés acquires 100% of its Travel subsidiary after buying 25% from Tool Factory
en.summary: El Corte Inglés has repurchased Tool Factory's remaining stake in its travel division, gaining full ownership following the previous merger with Logitravel.

stories.title: La deuda pone en alerta al mercado: "El riesgo del crudo es temporal, el fiscal no"

en.title: Debt puts market on alert: "Oil risk is temporary, fiscal risk is not"
en.summary: Bond yields are rising to unprecedented levels as investors demand higher returns, with US rates at their highest since 2002 and UK rates at multi-decade peaks, reflecting fiscal concerns.
